final_message:
Configured pc1 as the lab’s DNS server and pointed all 40 PCs and 8 routers to it. The requested names resolve to their machines’ existing addresses, and MX records direct mail for `company.com` and `university.edu` to pc7 and pc11 respectively. Existing connections and routes were left unchanged.

I checked all 17 address records against the startup configurations, verified both MX records, and checked the startup scripts’ shell syntax. I couldn’t run a live DNS test because Kathara and BIND tools aren’t available in this environment and Docker access is denied. The DNS configuration is in [named.conf](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-991r1k_0/lab/pc1/etc/bind/lab/named.conf).
